interface.title: Advanced Differential Gene Expression Dashboard
interface.stage_of_work: Downstream analysis: interpreting and reporting differential expression results that were already computed. Upstream, raw counts are run through DESeq2, edgeR or limma, for example with the R scripts the project README bundles; those steps happen outside this UI and produce the results table loaded here.
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a differential expression results table, map its columns, set fold-change and adjusted p-value cutoffs, explore the significant genes in volcano, MA, ranked-bar and distribution plots, look up genes of interest, and export the significant list as CSV or Excel.

data.note: sample_data.csv (51 genes; columns Gene, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean, pvalue, regulation) uploaded through the sidebar file uploader. The app has no built-in example. The Gene, log2FoldChange and padj columns were filled in automatically because their names matched. baseMean and regulation were mapped by hand later, but the app already used both columns before that because of their names. Many widget changes took one extra rerun to show, so some screenshots taken right after a click show the previous state (018, 019, 022, 024). Later screenshots (020, 025) show the true state.

features.name: Column-role mapper for an uploaded table
features.general: After a table is loaded, assign its columns to the roles the analysis needs (identifier, effect size, significance, plus optional extras in a collapsible section). Roles are pre-filled when column names match, and a success or error message is shown.
features.specific: Column Mapping selectboxes: Gene Name, Log2 Fold Change, Adjusted P-value, Regulation (Optional), and an expander with Mean Expression (baseMean) and Raw P-value. Each lists the CSV's headers and is pre-filled when names match. Columns literally named baseMean and regulation are also used by the MA plot and the regulation filter even while their mappings are None. Status reads 'Data processed successfully! 51 genes loaded' or shows the error box.
steps: Upload a CSV in the sidebar
Check the selections pre-filled by matching header names
Expand Additional Optional Columns and pick baseMean (and/or Raw P-value)
Optionally pick a Regulation column (no visible effect when the column is already named 'regulation')
Read the success or error status; the rest of the dashboard rebuilds from the mapping
serves_tasks: Assign table columns to the roles the analysis needs
Add optional columns that enable extra views

features.name: Dual-threshold significance sliders with live summary cards
features.general: Two sliders set an effect-size cutoff and a p-value cutoff; readouts echo the cutoffs and metric cards update the counts of significant, up and down items, which all downstream views use.
features.specific: log₂ Fold Change Threshold (0–5) and Adjusted P-value Threshold (0–0.1, step 0.005) sliders with help tooltips; log₂FC cutoff / p-adj cutoff readouts; Total / Significant / Upregulated / Downregulated cards with percentages; volcano caption 'Current thresholds: …'.
steps: Drag the fold-change slider (or use the arrow keys)
Drag the adjusted p-value slider
Read the updated cutoff readouts and summary cards
See the plots, table and export buttons follow the new classification (exports are greyed out when nothing passes)
serves_tasks: Set the statistical cutoff, trying several values

features.name: Volcano plot with switchable engine and interactive zoom/legend
features.general: Scatter of effect size against −log10 significance, coloured by up / down / not significant; hover for item details, box-zoom, hide categories from the legend, reset the view, and optionally draw it in a second chart style.
features.specific: Interactive Volcano Plot with a 'Select plot engine' radio (Plotly (Recommended) / Altair); hover shows Gene, log₂FC, padj, Regulation; Plotly toolbar has Zoom, Pan, Zoom in/out, Autoscale, Reset axes, PNG download; legend click toggles a category.
steps: Choose Plotly or Altair
Hover a point to read its gene and values
Drag a box to zoom into a cluster
Click a legend entry to hide 'Not Significant'
Press Reset axes
serves_tasks: See effect size against significance and pick out up- and down-regulated items
Zoom in on a cluster and hide a category

features.name: MA plot coloured by current significance
features.general: Plot effect size against log mean signal, with a zero reference line and points coloured by whether they pass the current cutoffs, to check for signal-dependent bias.
features.specific: MA Plot tab: log₂ Fold Change vs log₁₀ Mean Expression, dashed y=0 line, Significant True/False legend, Plotly hover and zoom; recolours when the thresholds change.
steps: Make sure a column named baseMean exists or is mapped (the tab draws whenever a column named baseMean is present, mapped or not)
Open the MA Plot tab
Adjust thresholds and watch points recolour
Hover a point for gene details
serves_tasks: Check whether effect size depends on overall signal level

features.general: Show the strongest significant changes as a diverging horizontal bar chart: up to N/2 items going up and N/2 going down, with a slider for N (an odd N shows N−1 bars).
